STEP 1 - Scene: A plated lunch or dinner: roasted chicken drumstick/thigh, roasted potato wedges, sautéed mushrooms, tomato pieces, and a green leafy salad (kale-like curly greens and spinach/chard leaves). Photographed from above, nearly top-down, with the square white plate filling most of the frame.

STEP 2 - Ruler: Square white plate roughly 26 cm across. Area ≈ 3.14 x (13)^2 ≈ 530 cm^2 (treating the square plate as close to a 26 cm dinner plate).

STEP 3 - Items:
- Chicken drumstick (skin-on, roasted)
- Roasted potato wedges (3 pieces)
- Mushrooms (about 6 whole/halved, sautéed)
- Cherry tomato pieces
- Mixed greens: curly kale and spinach/chard leaves, lightly dressed or oiled
- Light oil/glaze sheen on potatoes and chicken

STEP 4 - Area (of 530 cm^2):
- Chicken drumstick: 9% (~48 cm^2)
- Potato wedges: 7% (~37 cm^2)
- Mushrooms: 4% (~21 cm^2)
- Tomato pieces: 2% (~11 cm^2)
- Mixed greens: 20% (~106 cm^2)
Total covered ≈ 42% of the plate.

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Chicken: 48 cm^2 x 2.5 cm ≈ 120 ml
- Potatoes: 37 cm^2 x 2 cm ≈ 74 ml
- Mushrooms: 21 cm^2 x 1.5 cm ≈ 32 ml
- Tomato: 11 cm^2 x 1 cm ≈ 11 ml
- Greens: 106 cm^2 x 3 cm ≈ 318 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Chicken: 120 x 0.9 ≈ 108 g
- Potatoes: 74 x 0.8 ≈ 59 g
- Mushrooms: 32 x 0.5 ≈ 16 g
- Tomato: 11 x 0.6 ≈ 7 g
- Greens: 318 x 0.15 ≈ 48 g
- Oil/glaze: ~4 g

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Chicken (roasted, skin-on): 108 g x 200 kcal/100g ≈ 216 kcal
- Potatoes (roasted): 59 g x 150 ≈ 89 kcal
- Mushrooms (sautéed): 16 g x 30 ≈ 5 kcal
- Tomato: 7 g x 18 ≈ 1 kcal
- Greens (kale/spinach, dressed): 48 g x 35 ≈ 17 kcal
- Oil: 4 g x 880 ≈ 35 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: About 242 g of food, roughly 380 kcal. For a plate about 42% covered with a mix of protein, starch and greens, this is plausible.

Total ≈ 242 g, ≈ 380 kcal.
